rows.en: "Flag 1B0 has not been set. To play this private
event, set flag 1B0 and try again.
Otherwise, the event will be forcibly terminated."<FC:B4:3E>
Touya: "...She's not here..."
Yamato: "Huh?"
Touya: "Should we really have Gabon examine you?"
Yamato: "...Maybe we should..."
Aurelie: "Huh? What are you doing?"
Yamato: "Oh!"
Touya: "What are you doing there?"
Aurelie: "What? I'm just checking my Spirit Mech,
that's all..."
Yamato: "I see... That's why I couldn't tell where you were."
Touya: "?"
Yamato: "Spirit Mechs have special magnetic fields,
which were obscuring Aurelie's location.
All the Spirit Mechs gathered here must be affecting it."
Aurelie: "...Hup."
Aurelie: "What? Did you want something from me?"
Touya: "Y-Yeah. I just wanted to talk..."
Celica: "Well, well!"
Touya: "Whoa! Don't pop up out of nowhere!"
Celica: "How rude. I was here first.
Anyway, Touya, are you and Aurelie..."
Aurelie: "Wh...! N-No! Right?"
Touya: "What?"
Celica: "..."
Aurelie: "..."
Yamato: "...Sorry about him. He's just like that."
Celica: "...Well, I'd better get back to work."
Aurelie: "..."
Touya: "Huh?"
Yamato: "Sigh..."
Yamato: "Huh? The elevator's moving. That's unusual.
I wonder if anyone's inside."
Touya: "Of course people use it."
Yamato: "But it's always stopped when I see it,
on the very floor I'm on too."
Touya: "You're imagining it. Anyway..."
Yamato: "Oh, it stopped."
Fain: "Ha ha ha ha ha!
To protect those I love, my blade of justice strikes the foe!
My crimson blood burns bright red! That is the path of a man!
A man of justice and truth!
Faaain, Jiiin, Baaaarion!!
I have arrived! For justice... I could die!"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "...Huh?"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "Aaah!"
Fain: "H-Hey! Don't ignore me!
I went to all the trouble of waiting for you..."
Touya: "...You ought to have Gabon look at you sometime."
Fain: "What?! I'm perfectly healthy!
I'm not so weak that I'd get sick!
Dah ha ha ha!"
Yamato: "...It's serious."
Fain: "...So, what did you think? I have quite a bit of confidence
in this one. My own talent scares me!"
It's pretty good.
It sounds like enka.
Fain: "Right? That last part gives even me chills
when I say it."
Yamato: "He's drunk on himself... It's terminal."
Touya: "I-I see. Well, keep it up."
Fain: "'Enka'? What's that?"
Yamato: "Hmm, maybe you could call it 'a song from the Japanese
heart.'"
Fain: "Heart? So it's a song that speaks
directly to the soul?"
Yamato: "W-Well, something like that."
Fain: "Oh! So my speech is
just as wonderful!"
Yamato: "Y-Yeah... Maybe..."
Fain: "Dah ha ha ha! You understand!"
Yamato: "By the way, Fain, why are you so
straightforward?"
Fain: "Heh heh heh... Because I believe in justice!
To die for it would be my greatest wish!
And that justice is also for protecting those I hold dear!"
Touya: "Huh. Those you hold dear..."
Fain: "Yes! For the princess, and for Ymir,
and for K-Kasumi... No! My justice isn't
so fickle! Oh, what should I do...?"
Yamato: "...What do we do?"
Touya: "We'd better keep our distance..."
Fain: "We're friends, aren't we?!
Tell me, who should I fight for?
I've resolved to love only one woman.
But I have the noble, supreme duty
of protecting the princess. I can't abandon either loyalty or love.
Ah... What a trial! This is the fate of a knight!
Then I shall charge ahead to fight destiny!
No, wait. My master said that wanting too much at once
is the same as losing everything.
Does that mean I have to stay true to one or the other?!
Oh! What is this?!
And choosing between Ymir and Kasumi...
Ghh! This is all those ≪Ze=Ode≫ bastards' fault...
If it weren't for them, I'd never have to suffer
like this...
Ah! Could this be their conspiracy?!
Grrrr... Damn them... How despicable...
No, how fearsome ≪Ze=Ode≫ is!
But I, Fain Jin Barion, won't be discouraged
by something like this! Hmm? Then does that mean
that, to turn their plan against them, I must protect my love for two women
and my loyalty to the princess, all together?
Is that what I must do?
No, but that goes against my master's teachings.
Aaaaah! What should I do?!"
Fain: "...Huh? Touya? Hey..."
Yamato: "...He has his problems too."
Touya: "Well, he seems fulfilled in his own way.
Anyway, let's go."
Yamato: "Y-Yeah..."
